"""Bind the qualified tool-scan reduction to its evidence and source hashes."""

from datetime import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

ROOT = Path("/home/longhao/experiment/.worktrees/beliefkv-v25-followup-20261011")
OUTPUT = ROOT / "experiments/reports/v215_tool_scan_validation_20261013.json"
BENCHMARK = ROOT / "experiments/reports/v214_tool_lease_scan_cpu_20261013.json"
if OUTPUT.exists():
    raise ValueError("preserve previous qualification")
paths = (
    "beliefkv/runtime/sglang_v0520_runtime.py",
    "tests/test_tool_predictive_transfers.py",
    "scripts/benchmark_tool_lease_scan_cpu.py",
)
checks = (
    "tests/test_tool_predictive_transfers.py",
    "tests/test_native_transfer_policy.py",
    "tests/test_sglang_v0520_runtime.py",
    "tests/test_execution_handoff.py",
    "tests/test_join_transfer_windows.py",
)
source = {path: hashlib.sha256((ROOT / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in paths}
benchmark = json.loads(BENCHMARK.read_bytes())
if benchmark["optimized_runtime_sha256"] != source[paths[0]]:
    raise ValueError("CPU comparison source changed")
if len(benchmark["cases"]) != 12 or not all(case["outputs_equal"] for case in benchmark["cases"]):
    raise ValueError("missing or unequal CPU cases")
record = {
    "scope": "Tool-scan redundant lease maintenance reduction; no GPU-performance proof",

    "baseline_execution_revision": "f55e136c952a18b40198c254a93acb02ebf5c228",

    "qualified_paths_sha256": source,

        "command": ["/home/longhao/miniconda3/envs/beliefkv-next/bin/python", "-m", "pytest", "-q", *checks],
        "result": "406 passed in 1.24s",

            "Deferred tool scan leaves expiry to scheduler maintenance.",
            "Outside-window scan does not repeat all-lease refresh.",
            "Eligible scan revokes lost residency before computing restoration budget.",
            "Native lock release failure stops physical issuance and retains its receipt.",
        ],
    },
    "cpu_comparison": {
        "path": str(BENCHMARK.relative_to(ROOT)),
        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(BENCHMARK.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "cases": 12, "all_outputs_equal": True,
        "thread_cpu_reduction_for_156_contexts_with_4_to_48_leases": [
            case["thread_cpu_reduction"]["maintenance_and_scan"]
            for case in benchmark["cases"] if case["workflows"] == 156 and case["leases"] > 0

        "Fixture repeats known outside-window waits; no live hit frequency or JCT benefit is implied.",
        "Not a solution to JOIN remaining-work error, tool-round classification or throughput deficit.",
        "No cache of physical residency across scheduler iterations is added.",
    ],
    "helper_utf8_source": Path(__file__).read_text(),
    "helper_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
}
OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({"path": str(OUTPUT), "checks": 406, "cpu_cases": 12}))
